title: New-host staging build
summary: The application, sanitized database, process supervision, and builder lanes are live on staging. Side-index delivery and builder orientation remain pending.
evidence: The canonical sanitized database and both read-only builder copies share the same checksum and contain 26,559 content chunks.
The primary staging suite passed ten of ten tests.
The loopback-only service passed health, unauthorized, and authorized request smokes.
Each lane has a separate Unix account, branch, read-only database, prompt, report directory, and runtime sandbox.
Codex CLI 0.157.1 is pinned for Node 20 and Claude Code is absent.
Both Codex builder sandbox preflights passed.
limitations: Original side indexes, separate ChatGPT OAuth authorizations, orientation reports, reboot recovery, and pre-cutover sudo restriction remain required.
